name: holco-finance-controls
description: Check financial AI outputs with an open control protocol. Use these skills when a user wants to verify an AI-produced financial figure or statement against declared sources, run the local conformance demo (Python 3.11+, no API key, no network), or integrate the deterministic controls engine into an application or CI. The engine plans explicit controls, executes them, retains tamper-evident evidence, and always leaves the accountable decision with a human: a deterministic PASS is never a professional validation.
